descriptionChirho: Proper feminine noun Yehudit (יְהוּדִית) used adverbially to mean 'in the Judean/Jewish language,' referring to Hebrew as spoken by the people of Judah, occurring in 2 Kings 18:26, 18:28, 2 Chronicles 32:18, Isaiah 36:11, 36:13, and Nehemiah 13:24. Both sense clusters cover the same linguistic referent with no semantic distinction between them. Target languages confirm unity: Spanish en judío/judaico, Hindi यहूदी/इब्रानी में, Arabic بِالْيَهُودِيَّةِ, Korean 유다 말로, Swahili Kiyahudi.
